text.p: Results on the final day of four-day English county championship cricket matches on Saturday:

At Cheltenham: Gloucestershire beat Durham by an innings and 28 runs. Gloucestershire 471-6 declared (M.Alleyne 169, J.Russell 103 not out; M.Windows 75, S.Young 52; S.Brown 4-120). Durham 86 and 357 (J.Lewis 81, D.Boon 66; M.Alleyne 4-69). Gloucestershire 24 points, Durham 2.

At Chesterfield: Match abandoned as a draw - rain. Derbyshire 513-6 declared (A.Rollins 148; M.May 116, V.Clarke 76 not out) and 35-0. Glamorgan 364-8 declared (A.Dale 142 not out). Derbyshire 10 points, Glamorgan 9.
At Chelmsford: Match drawn. Worcestershire 394 and 250-5 declared (G.Hick 107 not out, D.Leatherdale 59 not out). Essex 451 (D.Robinson 148, P.Prichard 120). Essex 8 points, Worcestershire 8.

At Southampton: Match drawn. Lancashire 569-8 declared and 255-9 declared (W.Hegg 77 not out; J.Bovill 4-62). Hampshire 412-4 declared (M.Keech 101 not out, J.Laney 95, M.Hayden 94). Hampshire 10 points, Lancashire 8.

At Northampton: Match drawn. Surrey 581-7 declared (A.Brown 170 not out, D.Bicknell 162, A.Hollioake 81). Northamptonshire 401 and 241-2 declared (A.Fordham 82 not out, R.Bailty 62 not out). Northampton 9 points, Surrey 10.
At Leicester: Match drawn. Nottinghamshire 342 and 182 (A.Mullally 5-62). Leicestershire 267 and 217-9 (V.Wells 59; A.Oram 4-69). Leicestershire 9 points, Nottinghamshire 10.
At Edgbaston: Warwickshire 336 (A.Giles 97, T.Frost 56; Mushtaq Ahmed 5-66) and 0-0. Somerset 304-6 declared (P.Holloway 106, M.Trescothick 57).
